ModMetaData.name: Sloppy Trashbrick Burning
ModMetaData.author: kanid99
ModMetaData.description:
Burn the trashbricks from Vanilla Recycling Expanded for power.
Adds a trashbrick pellet stove: a small generator that you fill with trashbricks. It produces 1000W and warms the room it stands in, like the wood-fired generator. One garbage compactor makes about enough bricks to keep one stove running.
Needs Vanilla Recycling Expanded, and is researched after complex recycling.
